description: List the publishable keys that let a non-Shopify website send on-site events (product views, cart activity, collection views, search, and page views reported with sequenzy.page()) into this workspace. Whether browse abandonment, cart recovery, or any product-view trigger can work on a custom site depends on an installed key: without one those events never arrive, the sequences built on them never fire, and nothing reports an error anywhere. Each key returns `allowedOrigins`, `allowedAppIds` (iOS bundle IDs and Android package names for the mobile SDKs), `unrestricted`, `lastUsedAt`, and a paste-ready `installSnippet`. A key with `lastUsedAt: null` has not successfully authenticated an event yet; it may be undeployed, have no instrumented traffic, or be sending requests rejected by its origin or app ID allowlist. Shopify stores do not use these keys; they use the storefront pixel, which get_integration_pixel reports.
